_: Commanding the King's hosts (realm/scripts/host_command.gd; Warcraft III's fixed command card and ground ring, Total War's banner that glows when selected and its route on the campaign map). on: the switch (or --hosts=on / --hosts=off). A click selects the host whose standard-bearer or regiment it meets (host_pick.gd: a physics ray at the press, no screen-distance guess). ring: the ground ring under a selected host (radius in world units, plus so much per company, up to max; colour). glow: the light on a selected host's banner. route: the dotted line to where a host is ordered (dot size and spacing in world units; colour, and alpha for a host not selected). town_reach: an order given this near a town's centre, in world units (a tile is 4), goes to the town rather than to the ground. orders: the command card, left to right (READY.md line 8: march, attack, besiege, hold, go home; research section 1 point 8), each with its icon (realm/assets/icons, Phosphor) and words on hover, aim: true for an order that waits for the King to click where (the ground, a town, a foe), and send: the bridge's order it is when that is another's name (Besiege is the bridge's march on a foe's town: bridge/hosts.js lays siege on arrival, campaigns.js assaults each season until Freeciv's conquest takes it, READY.md line 7); its hotkey is the Input Map action host_<order> (keys.gd, changeable in Settings). doing: what the card says the host is doing, by its order's kind ({to} where it is bound, {road} how many seasons away; there: once it has arrived). face (Total War's drag to face, research point 7): with a host selected, a right-drag longer than drag_px on screen draws the line the host will form on, a ghost mark per company (ghost: size and colour), and on release marches it there facing away from the line as dragged (left to right faces up the screen).

orders.tip: March: then click where on the map, or a town (right-click also marches; right-drag to set the line it forms on)
Attack: then click a foe's host to fall on it
Besiege: then click a foe's town to lay siege to it and take it
Garrison: then click a town of yours or of a house sworn to you
Go home: march home to the King's seat
Split: half its companies stand apart as a host of their own

_troops: troops: how a host's strength reads on its card ({men} the count; Mac: troops, not men).

cursor._: While an order waits for the King to click where (host_command.gd _cursor; Warcraft III's order cursor): the pointer is that order's card icon, size px square, filled in the accent (red for an attack or a siege) on a dark rim this many px wide; its hotspot at the middle.

marker._: Where an order lands, a ring flashed on the ground (Warcraft III's command marker): from and to, its width at the start and end in world units, secs how long it takes to close and fade, energy its glow; the accent for a march, red for an attack or a siege.

result._: The King's battle when it is over (battle_card.gd; CK3's battle summary; bridge battles.js): told once, bottom-left over the ticker (above: px up from the screen's foot), for show_s seconds or until clicked. head_won / head_lost: its head ({place}: 'at Redmarch', 'near Redmarch', 'in the open field'); victor: after the side that won; men / lost: each side's men and its losses; fell: the King's captains who fell there ({names}, each as captain).

left._: The card's line on the selected host's orders this season (bridge hosts.json ordersPerHost, /world hosts[].ordersLeft): one, with one left; some, with {n} the orders left; none, when spent; why, the greyed buttons' tip.
left.none: The captains have their orders this season
left.why: The captains have their orders this season. The next goes with the turn of the season.
